Definition: accepted species name (single-species, single-specimen BigBrain series)
Note: applies to all 12 items of the series (Dickscheid_etal_2021_Area44 ... Dickscheid_etal_2021_AreahOc5); one definitions file for the series
Source Note: species from the KG specimen metadata (subject sub-20, Homo sapiens, male, 65 years); not printed in the data files

Definition: species as published; printed-name invariant (the data files never print a species name; the KG record's specimen tree says Homo sapiens)
Source Note: KG dataset-version record, specimenBySubject: sub-20, Homo sapiens, male, 65 year; tissue sample B20 (fresh brain), collection brain-20

Definition: the BigBrain (Amunts et al. 2013, Science 340:1472-1475): one post-mortem brain of a 65-year-old male donor, formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded, 7404 20-micron sections, Merker silver stain for cell bodies, scanned at 1 micron
Note: n = 1 brain for every item; the per-area values are patch means within that one brain, not species means
Source Note: DataDescriptor pdf (METHODS) and dataset README.md in ebrains_downloads/<area_dir>/v1.0/

Definition: Julich-Brain cytoarchitectonic area the dataset belongs to, as named in the KG record (studiedBrainRegion), e.g. 'Area 44 (IFG)', 'Area hOc1 (V1, 17, CalcS)'
Note: patch locations were chosen near the centre of the Julich-Brain probabilistic map of the area projected to BigBrain (DataDescriptor, METHODS)
Source Note: KG record field studiedBrainRegion, value '<area> (Julich-Brain Atlas)'

Definition: folder name of the dataset in the EBRAINS data-proxy bucket p22717-hbp-d000061_BB-CorticalCellDistribution_pub (e.g. Broca_44, Visual_hOc1); joins to reference_tables/Dickscheid_etal_2021_datasets.csv (area_dir) and to the snapshot (area_dir)
cortical layer: I, II, III, IV, V, VI as manually annotated in each patch (layerinfo.txt 'Name'), or 'I-VI' = all six layers pooled per patch (whole cortical depth)
Note: 'I-VI' is computed in the build: per patch all cells of layers I-VI divided by the summed layer volume; thickness = summed layer thicknesses
Source Note: layer annotation by one of three experts in microdraw, checked by a second (4-eye principle; DataDescriptor)

Definition: density of segmented cell bodies (all cell types: neurons + glia; silver stain) in the layer, mean over the dataset's image patches; per patch: n_cells_in_layer / (Area_micron2 x 20 micron x 1.931^(1/3) / 1e6); unit # detected cells per 0.1 mm^3
Note: identical to siibra LayerwiseCellDensity per-patch values (verified 731/731 rows) and to the dataset's averaged report stats.pdf bars (143/144 layer means within 0.01; Area 4a layer III differs by 0.197 because the deposited segments.txt of patch 3196/0001 has 64 fewer layer-III cells than the pre-rendered report); multiply by 10 for cells per mm^3
Source Note: # detected cells / 0.1mm3 (y-axis label of stats.pdf and report.pdf; siibra unit '# detected cells / $0.1mm^3$')

Definition: standard deviation of the per-patch densities over the n_patches patches
Note: computed in the build (stats::sd); not published as such

Definition: unit string of cell_density: '# detected cells / 0.1 mm^3' with the shrinkage treatment spelled out

average thickness of the layer in the patch (layerinfo.txt 'AvgThickness(micron)'), mean over patches; micron as measured in the section image, i.e. of the shrunken tissue -- NOT shrinkage-corrected (the averaged report stats.pdf plots these uncorrected values; multiply by 1.931^(1/3) = 1.2454 for a linear shrinkage correction)
Note: the dataset README states the factor is applied in the pdf reports; numerically it is not (all 72 thickness bars equal the uncorrected means)

Definition: standard deviation of the per-patch layer thickness over the patches
unit string of layer_thickness
number of cortical image patches of the dataset (one value per patch enters each layer mean; 9-11 per area)
Note: the DataDescriptor says 10 per area were selected; the buckets hold 9-11

Definition: number of distinct BigBrain tissue sections the patches come from (a section can carry 2 patches)
total number of segmented cell bodies counted in the layer over all patches (sum of segments.txt rows with that layer index)
Note: cells with layer index 0 or 7 (outside layers I-VI) are excluded; counts are per 20-micron section image, not per volume

Definition: DOI of the EBRAINS dataset version (10.25493/...); = registry column C and the stem of the public TSV name
EBRAINS Knowledge Graph dataset-version UUID (https://search.kg.ebrains.eu/instances/<uuid>); its record is frozen in ebrains_downloads/kg_records/<uuid>.json

all segmented cell bodies (neurons AND glia), silver-stained (modified Merker 1983), segmented automatically by a Contour Proposal Network (Upschulte et al. 2022, score threshold 0.9); no neuron/glia distinction, no stereological correction
Note: do not pool with neuron-only densities (NeuN, isotropic fractionator) without a correction

Definition: per patch and layer: volume (0.1 mm^3) = Area_micron2 x 20 micron x 1.931^(1/3) / 1e6; density = n_cells_in_layer / volume; the layer mean is the arithmetic mean over patches (a patch with 0 cells in a layer counts as 0)
Note: same as siibra 1.0.1a27 features/tabular/layerwise_cell_density.py and as the dataset's stats.pdf; 1.931 = volumetric shrinkage factor from the dataset README

Definition: density kept as published (# detected cells per 0.1 mm^3); thickness micron (uncorrected); no project-unit conversion applies
one row = one Julich-Brain area x layer within ONE brain (BigBrain): a mean over 9-11 image patches of that brain; not a species mean and not a population value
